operations.item_text: User can access TaskFlow under a session-prefixed URL of the form /s/<sessionid>/tasks where sessionid is a 32-character lowercase hex UUID
operations.rationale: new requirement; will allocate AC-012 and let Stage 1 record the asset

operations.item_text: User visiting a fresh session URL sees an empty task list with the create form available; the session is created implicitly on first write with no signup required
operations.rationale: new requirement; will allocate AC-013 and let Stage 1 record the asset

operations.item_text: User visiting a URL with a malformed session ID (not the literal "default" and not a 32-character lowercase hex string) receives an HTTP 404 response
operations.rationale: new requirement; will allocate AC-014 and let Stage 1 record the asset

operations.item_text: Tasks, archives, labels, and priorities created under one session are invisible and untouchable from any other session
operations.rationale: new requirement; will allocate AC-015 and let Stage 1 record the asset

unmatched_items.text: Task list and Archive page now reflect only data from the active session
The "Archive completed" bulk action and its count reflect only completed tasks in the active session
